metaDescription: Order custom tissues and wipes with carabiner for easy on-the-go access. Perfect for giveaways and safety kits. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Adding a carabiner to custom tissues and wipes makes them portable and practical for outdoor workers, event attendees, or anyone on the move. Clip them to a belt loop, backpack, or tool belt for instant access. Choose from soft tissue packs or disinfecting wipes, both easily decorated with your logo via screen printing or foil stamping. Ideal for safety managers outfitting crews or marketers handing out useful swag at trade shows.
